title: A clear full-on result with numbers
plain: It records a strong, well-sourced result and reports it in the agreed three lines.

messages.text:
*<https://experiments.example.com/experiments/9001|obe/checkout/date-prefill> is going FULL ON* :rocket:
*Result:* Bayes analysis shows *8.7 to 1 odds* in favour of the variant, projecting *+14.2 bookings per day*.
*Hypothesis:* Prefilling the check-in date for returning users will reduce friction at checkout.
